# Anomalocarids
## Heat Vent Anomalocarids are thermal vent dwellers, and to withstand the cold of the deep sea, their bodies developed a natural self heating ability through a mysterious chemical reaction. Outside of water this reaction can quickly spiral out of control, [color=#ffa500]requiring them to regularly vent their excess heat as water vapor.[/color]
## Damage Living near thermal vents has adapted Anomalocarids to the heat, giving them [color=#1e90ff]25% extra resistance to heat damage.[/color] Unfortunately, time spent out of the water has thinned their exoskeletons and made them more susceptible to cold temperatures, leaving them [color=#ffa500]25% more vulnerable to cold damage,[/color] and [color=#ffa500]15% more vulnerable to blunt and piercing damage. [/color]. Despite the softening of their exoskeletons, they still provide [color=#1e90ff]15% extra resistance against slashing damage.[/color] Fortunately, their [color=#ffa500]strange origin[/color] has made them [color=#1e90ff]10% more resistant to poisons and radiation.[/color]
## Anomalocarid Naming Conventions Anomalocarid names are typically combinations of bubbling and clicking sounds, unpronouncable to most other species. To make things easier for their non-Anomalocarid friends, most Anomalocarids will add a nautical term to the start of their names. Rarely, some Anomalocarids may even combine the name of someone in their life they find important with their own birth name. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Dredge Glbglb - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Wake Blblbl - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Rusty Lblbl - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] The Balance of Blblglb - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Be Courteous To Blblbl - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Dan Grglblgr - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Shrimp Man - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Corona Virus - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Brbrbring Me To Life
## Lore
Anomalocarid are notable in being that they are a species with definitive proof of being a reverse engineering of another species into a more sentient form. This venture was taken by the company Discount Dan's™ in 4XXX when they were attempting to harness the deliciousness of underwater shrimp and needed a workforce who could operate within thermal vents. The Anomalocarids have since formed their own societies after their existence was discovered by the wider galaxxy, with some choosing to stay in the service of Discount Dan's™ and reaping the benefits while others chose to journey through the stars.
